skills.name: discover-important-function
skills.description: Ranks fuzz-worthy Python files and public input boundaries before harness authoring.
skills.useWhen: A Python repository needs a small, evidence-backed shortlist of fuzz targets.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The target and rationale are already fixed, or the task is only to implement a known harness.

skills.name: fuzzing-python
skills.description: Builds a minimal coverage-guided Atheris/LibFuzzer harness for a selected Python target.
skills.useWhen: The Python target is already selected and the coverage-guided harness structure is missing.
skills.doNotUseWhen: The task only selects targets, fixes a localized bug, or already supplies a complete runnable harness.
